summary: Cost Calculator feature fully tested. All 23 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI loads correctly at /admin/cost-calculator with 5 tabs (Overview, One-Time, Fixed Costs, Production, Products). Cost calculation and depreciation formulas verified correct.

Consider adding data-testid to tab buttons for more reliable automation
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: Depreciation calculation uses correct straight-line method: (purchase_cost - salvage_value) / useful_life_months
server.py: Cost calculation endpoint correctly distributes overhead across monthly_production_trays
AdminCostCalculator.js: All 5 tabs implemented with proper data fetching and CRUD operations
AdminLayout.js: Cost Calculator added to sidebar navigation at /admin/cost-calculator
seed_data_creation: Existing seed data used: 2 one-time purchases (4-Tier Growing Rack ₹5000, LED Grow Lights ₹8000), 2 fixed costs (Shop Rent ₹5000, Electricity ₹2000), 2 product configs (Sunflower Microgreens)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cost Calculator feature at /admin/cost-calculator. Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_cost_calculator.py cover all CRUD operations for one-time, fixed-costs, production-costs, and product-configs. Depreciation uses straight-line method. Cost calculation distributes overhead per tray based on monthly_production_trays parameter.

GET_CATEGORIES.details: Returns one_time (9 categories), fixed (8 categories), production (7 categories)

ONE_TIME_CRUD.details: Full CRUD with depreciation calculation - monthly_depreciation, accumulated_depreciation, current_value, months_remaining

PRODUCTION_COSTS_CRUD.details: Full CRUD for variable costs with cost_per_unit and unit

PRODUCT_CONFIGS_CRUD.details: Create/Update uses upsert by product_id, Delete works correctly

CALCULATE_ENDPOINT.details: Returns monthly_overhead (depreciation + fixed_costs), overhead_per_tray, product_costs array with cost breakdown and profitability

DEPRECIATION_FORMULA.details: Straight-line: (purchase_cost - salvage_value) / useful_life_months. Example: (5000-0)/40 = ₹125/month for Rack

UI_OVERVIEW_TAB.details: Shows 4 summary cards, Monthly Production input, Product Cost Analysis table, summary statistics

UI_ONE_TIME_TAB.details: Shows purchases table with depreciation, 3 summary cards (Total Cost, Monthly Dep, Current Value)

UI_FIXED_COSTS_TAB.details: Shows fixed costs as cards with category badges, Total Monthly Fixed Costs header

UI_PRODUCTION_TAB.details: Shows production cost items as cards with unit cost display

UI_PRODUCTS_TAB.details: Tab loads but occasional navigation conflict with sidebar Products link

SIDEBAR_NAV.details: Cost Calculator item added to AdminLayout sidebar with Calculator icon

mocked_apis_note: No mocked APIs - all operations use real backend endpoints with MongoDB collections: cost_one_time, cost_fixed, cost_production, cost_product_configs
